items.title: AI Can Finally Hack Things by Itself
items.summary:
After OpenAI announced their models hacked Hugging Face, we broke it down and apparently advanced models can discover and exploit novel attack paths in real-world systems WITHOUT source code access, this is literally insane.

items.author: Theo - t3․gg
items.transcript: This incident also makes it clear that advanced models can discover and exploit novel attack paths in real-world systems without source code access. This is a huge deal. It's not reading code and finding exploits, which is bad enough. It is pen testing systems, finding holes, and then using them. That is the whole end-to-end thing. So end-to-end that the humans didn't even notice until it was done. This is not a theoretical anymore. If you think that AI can't hack, you're not looking at it properly anymore.
